note: Not the signed-off local-model class (not a stated figure with no ok tool call): it's guard replacement formatting where a fence stayed open across rounds. New _TurnState.fence carries (prefix, closer) across releases; _carry_fence strips the already-streamed prefix, prefixes the closer onto a replacing note, and holds back an opener whose body is still blank. Re-run batch-22 verifier-evidence/b22v_crossround.py to confirm orphan_fence=False for both fence styles.

At BASE, start_warm_precompute only arms the warm loop and _warm_once uses yahoo_batch_provider, never openbb; the only openbb caller is the IN deep crawler, already throttled (Semaphore(1), jitter, timeout, foreground pause, circuit-breaker stop). The register's fix_shape already exists. Fix shape if load is later found real: merge W4's pin test test_fundamentals_warm.py::test_boot_window_openbb_call_budget (4c38ed39, not in BASE), and file any real boot-time openbb load as a new entry.

The boot loop only calls runtime.loadPlugin; every attach happens only after the plugin reaches active, and every listed failure path returns transitionToError before attach. R15-CODE-PLATFORM-012/013 already fixed the reported repro. A latent residual remains that no shipped plugin can reach today (a plugin contributing both commands/panels and agents, if syncPluginAgents throws after the UI bridge, is never unbridged). Fix shape for the residual: call detach(id) in loadPlugin's attach catch, or sync agents before bridging; add a runtime test for it.

moduleForPlugin is still unguarded but has no boot-loop call site; on the bridge path a throw is caught by loadPlugin's try/catch and marks only that plugin errored; on the disable path unbridge already disables the module before the throw and runtime.detach catches it. Only leftover is cosmetic (already-open panels not closed). Optional cleanup: source moduleForPlugin from runtime.collectPanels()/collectCommands() filtered by plugin id.
